report.title: 核心资产依然优质，但回报率取决于资本效率能否守住

thesis.text: 我的初始判断是：Alphabet仍是极强的资产组合，核心业务的现金创造力和增长质量没有问题；但未来3到5年的关键不在于能否继续增长，而在于增长是否足以覆盖更高的资本开支、算力与数据中心投入、AI广告形态变化以及监管成本上升，并维持足够好的资本回报。

sections.title: 公司仍是以搜索广告为底座、云与AI为第二增长曲线的组合体

paragraphs.text: Alphabet的业务组合仍然很清晰：Google是主体，且Google又分为Google Services和Google Cloud，非Google业务归入Other Bets。Google Services覆盖Search、YouTube、Android、Chrome、Gmail、Maps、Play和设备等，收入主要来自广告，也包括订阅、应用内购和设备销售；Google Cloud主要靠按量付费和订阅收费，提供基础设施、平台、应用与协作工具；Other Bets则主要来自自动驾驶和互联网服务，并处于不同早期阶段。公司还把部分AI基础研究和前沿模型开发集中在Alphabet-level activities，说明AI是横跨核心业务的共用能力，而不是独立的新故事。

citations.quote: Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence.
For reporting purposes Google comprises two segments: Google Services and Google Cloud.

We have always been committed to building helpful products that can improve the lives of millions of people worldwide. Our product innovations are what make our services widely used, and our brand one of the most recognized in the world. Google Services' core products and platforms include ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Gemini, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube, with broad and growing adoption by users around the world.

Google Services generates revenues primarily by delivering both performance and brand advertising that appears on Google Search & other properties, YouTube, and Google Network partners' properties ("Google Network properties"). We continue to invest in both performance and brand advertising and seek to improve the measurability of advertising so advertisers understand the effectiveness of their campaigns.

Through our Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace offerings, Google Cloud generates revenues primarily from consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, applications, and other cloud services. Customers use Google Cloud in multiple ways such as:

Other Bets operate as independent companies and some of them have their own boards with independent members and outside investors. While these early-stage businesses naturally come with considerable uncertainty, some of them are already generating revenue and making important strides in their industries. Revenues from Other Bets are generated primarily from the sale of autonomous transportation and internet services.

sections.title: 竞争压力真实存在，最大的不确定性在广告与AI的共同演化

paragraphs.text: Alphabet面对的不是单一赛道竞争，而是搜索、广告、云、AI产品和消费硬件被同时重估的竞争环境。10-K直接列出的对手包括通用搜索、垂直搜索、电商、广告平台、数字内容与应用平台、企业云、AI模型与AI产品、消费硬件、数字视频、社交网络以及办公通信工具。对Alphabet而言，核心压力有两层：一是广告需求与宏观环境联动，且AI正在改变广告投放和交付方式，管理层承认未必能持续有效适应；二是隐私、广告屏蔽、合作伙伴条款和监管变化会影响广告服务与TAC rate。因而它的护城河仍在，但已不是静态垄断，而是一个必须持续用产品、数据和算力维系的动态系统。

citations.quote: Our business is characterized by rapid change as well as new and disruptive technologies. We face formidable competition in every aspect of our business, including but not limited to, from:
•general purpose search engines and information services;
•providers of enterprise cloud services;
•AI model developers and providers of AI products and services;

Changes to our advertising policies and data privacy practices, as well as changes to other companies' advertising or data privacy practices have in the past, and may in the future, affect the advertising services that we are able to provide. In addition, technologies have been developed that make personalized ads more difficult, or that block the display of ads altogether, and some providers of online services have integrated technologies that could impair the availability and functionality of third-party digital advertising. Failing to provide superior value or deliver advertisements effectively and competitively could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results.

Expenditures by advertisers tend to correlate with overall economic conditions. Adverse macroeconomic conditions have affected, and may in the future affect, the demand for advertising, resulting in fluctuations in the amounts our advertisers spend on advertising, which could harm our financial condition and operating results.

sections.title: 2025年仍是高质量增长，但增长正在以更重的资本开支换取

paragraphs.text: 2025年Alphabet总收入4028.36亿美元，同比增长15.09%；营业利润1290.39亿美元，营业利润率31.98%；净利润1321.70亿美元。分部上，Google Services收入3427.21亿美元，同比增长12.39%，营业利润1394.04亿美元，营业利润率40.68%；Google Cloud收入587.05亿美元，同比增长35.96%，营业利润139.10亿美元，营业利润率23.68%。与此同时，公司披露2025年资本开支为914亿美元，而2024年为525亿美元；管理层明确表示2026年将相对2025年“显著增加”对技术基础设施、服务器、网络设备和数据中心的投资。

sections.title: 没有股价与预期输入，无法做出估值判断

paragraphs.text: 价格是否合适，单靠这份10-K不能下结论。我们知道Alphabet在2025年实现了15.09%的收入增长和31.98%的营业利润率，审计意见也未显示报表层面的保留意见，但这些都不足以替代估值输入。缺少当前股价、流通股与市值、净现金/债务以及市场对2026-2028年收入和资本开支的预期，无法判断其是否被低估或高估。

sections.title: 重点跟踪AI变现、云利润率、资本开支回报和监管成本

paragraphs.text: 后续最重要的观察点有四个：第一，AI搜索形态（如AI Overviews、AI Mode）是否能在不明显削弱广告变现的情况下提升用户参与和商业转化；第二，Google Cloud能否继续高增长并把利润率维持在扩张轨道上；第三，2026年更高的资本开支是否能转化为足够的收入和效率回报，否则折旧、能耗、租赁和网络成本会压低利润质量；第四，监管、隐私和诉讼成本是否继续抬升。另一个值得注意的非经营事项是，公司在2026年1月确认约320亿美元非上市投资未实现收益，这说明资产端可能仍有重估空间，但其兑现方式与持续性仍未明。

There is no assurance that we will adapt effectively and competitively to meet this shift, and that such advertising formats, strategies, and offerings will be successful.

sections.title: 关注AI变现、云利润率、资本开支回报和监管成本

paragraphs.text: 后续最重要的观察点有四个：第一，AI搜索形态（如AI Overviews、AI Mode）是否能在不显著损害广告变现的情况下提升用户参与和商业转化；第二，Google Cloud能否继续高增长并把营业利润率维持在扩张通道中；第三，2026年大幅增加的资本开支能否换来足够的收入和效率回报，否则折旧、能耗和网络成本会压制利润质量；第四，监管、隐私和诉讼成本是否继续抬升。另一个值得注意的非经营事项是，公司在2026年1月确认约320亿美元非上市投资的未实现收益，这说明资产端可能仍有价值重估空间，但其最终兑现方式和稳定性仍未明。

sections.title: 公司仍是以搜索广告为底座、云与AI为第二增长曲线的组合体

paragraphs.text: Alphabet的业务组合仍然很清晰：Google是主体，且Google又分为Google Services和Google Cloud，非Google业务归入Other Bets。Google Services覆盖Search、YouTube、Android、Chrome、Gmail、Maps、Play和设备等，收入主要来自广告，也包括订阅、应用内购和设备销售；Google Cloud主要靠按量付费和订阅收费，提供基础设施、平台、应用与协作工具；Other Bets则主要来自自动驾驶和互联网服务，并处于不同早期阶段。公司还把部分AI基础研究和前沿模型开发集中在Alphabet-level activities，说明AI是横跨核心业务的共用能力，而不是独立的新故事。

citations.quote: Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence.
For reporting purposes Google comprises two segments: Google Services and Google Cloud.

We have always been committed to building helpful products that can improve the lives of millions of people worldwide. Our product innovations are what make our services widely used, and our brand one of the most recognized in the world. Google Services' core products and platforms include ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Gemini, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube, with broad and growing adoption by users around the world.

Google Services generates revenues primarily by delivering both performance and brand advertising that appears on Google Search & other properties, YouTube, and Google Network partners' properties ("Google Network properties"). We continue to invest in both performance and brand advertising and seek to improve the measurability of advertising so advertisers understand the effectiveness of their campaigns.

Through our Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace offerings, Google Cloud generates revenues primarily from consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, applications, and other cloud services. Customers use Google Cloud in multiple ways such as:

Other Bets operate as independent companies and some of them have their own boards with independent members and outside investors. While these early-stage businesses naturally come with considerable uncertainty, some of them are already generating revenue and making important strides in their industries. Revenues from Other Bets are generated primarily from the sale of autonomous transportation and internet services.

sections.title: 竞争压力真实存在，最大的不确定性在广告与AI的共同演化

paragraphs.text: Alphabet面对的不是单一赛道竞争，而是搜索、广告、云、AI产品和消费硬件被同时重估的竞争环境。10-K直接列出的对手包括通用搜索、垂直搜索、电商、广告平台、数字内容与应用平台、企业云、AI模型与AI产品、消费硬件、数字视频、社交网络以及办公通信工具。对Alphabet而言，核心压力有两层：一是广告需求与宏观环境联动，且AI正在改变广告投放和交付方式，管理层承认未必能持续有效适应；二是隐私、广告屏蔽、合作伙伴条款和监管变化会影响广告服务与TAC rate。因而它的护城河仍在，但已不是静态垄断，而是一个必须持续用产品、数据和算力维系的动态系统。

•providers of enterprise cloud services;
•AI model developers and providers of AI products and services;
